Defer this comparison until that value is read and confirmed to match, rather than substituting a different horizon; if none matches, report the operation not executable.

A prediction_braking comparison at one saved projected state would measure local endpoint speed/position differences between the recorded applied tension and an instantaneous braking-box input, but it cannot separate objective weighting, seed/iteration selection, horizon truncation and backend-model mismatch when they predict the same local result, nor identify a dominant settling cause. Defer any dominance claim until the retained per-update tension, state, prediction, selected-iteration and raw-status series are read.

The retained recipe carries terminal_tip_speed_weight 0.0, holding_tip_speed_weight 0.0 and very small velocity_weight / terminal_velocity_weight (0.0001), which is compatible with a plan that does not strongly penalize residual tip speed; however, raw weight magnitudes do not establish cost-term importance without actual per-term contributions or scaling, none of which are retained, so this remains a candidate rather than an established cause.

initialization_selected 29 versus noninitialization_selected 6 indicates most recorded updates selected the initialization/seed iterate, and 34 of 35 raw statuses are User_Requested_Stop; the applied plan may therefore reflect an unconverged or early-truncated iterate. Per-update optimization_selected_iteration and optimization_raw_status series were retained but not read within the two-turn evidence limit, and optimize iteration traces are not retained, so this cannot be separated from stopping behaviour here.

mean_update_s 17.075238151415917 against control_period_s 0.01 shows each recorded solve far exceeded its wall deadline, and the authorized local checks use only a 0.01 s projected horizon while the failing settling window is 0.05 s inside a 0.35 s record; a 10 ms projected probe cannot explain the whole settling failure, so horizon/truncation effects and objective weighting can predict the same local result and are not separable with these tools.

Reach passing while the sampled backend motion fails settling is compatible with a projection/plant-model difference, but no retained artifact read in this phase compares projected one_step_prediction endpoints against measured backend evolution for the same update ids (those series were retained but not read), so this hypothesis is not evaluated rather than supported or excluded.
